name: JEEBench
description: JEEBench is a challenging benchmark dataset designed to evaluate large language models on problem-solving abilities in pre-engineering mathematics, physics, and chemistry. It contains 515 problems from the IIT JEE-Advanced exam requiring long-horizon reasoning and deep domain knowledge.
reputation: A niche but credible benchmark from the research literature, mainly used in papers studying advanced reasoning on competitive-exam-style STEM problems.
notes: Focuses on challenging engineering exam problems; highlights failure modes of GPT-4 and proposes confidence-thresholding method.
